scope: strict-FP64 derivative-only combined mapping against the qualified post-#411 baseline
stability_rule: At both 384 and 768 AO, the median candidate/auto force ratio must be <= 0.97 and a paired bootstrap 95% upper ratio bound must be < 1.0. Report every paired ratio and its spread; do not pool changed-work or failed samples.
order: auto/candidate on even repeats, candidate/auto on odd repeats
initial_density: same archived checkpoint; warm-start updates disabled for every arm
work_gates: normal convergence and final-state checks remain active; require 3 updates at 384/768 plus matching actual J/K builds, eigensolves, corrections and retries from a separate diagnostic pass
small_domain: 96/192 numerical regressions and automatic fallback work; explicit candidate selection is diagnostic and does not expand the promoted automatic domain
timing: synchronized clean endpoints only; all compilation must finish before the finite Slurm timing allocation; diagnostics follow clean repetitions
promotion: a class-kernel win alone is insufficient; retain a negative result if the combined endpoint gate fails
